name: 13202 · Syracuse, NY
findings: ZIP 13202 (Syracuse) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13202 (Syracuse) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13202 (Syracuse) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.8 times the typical level).
